_comment: Batch-2 (docs/24) paid desktop installer runtime — single source of truth. NOT the currently shipped path: today's guided install uses Ollama (see downloads.html / frontend/assets/build.js). Nothing here is user-facing until the signed installer ships.
why: Self-contained, MIT-licensed, no external engine dependency; matches the docs/21 cloud path so local and cloud share one runtime. Digest-pinned so the installer runs exactly the build we froze at release.
distribution: bundled inside the signed desktop installer (P0-8)

pin.digest_status: measured at release build and frozen here; the installer refuses to run an image whose digest does not match. Left null until the first signed build so we never ship a fabricated digest.

status: batch-2 target — planned, not yet shipped
